# Steam purchase dates: appid + purchase date (YYYY-MM-DD), one per line.
# Used ONLY as the fallback start date for games with no achievement-derived
# first-play signal (nothing unlocked / no achievement schema).
#
# Regenerate from saved account/history pages (scroll "Load more history"
# back through the years, then Ctrl-S) with:
#   STEAM_API_KEY=... STEAM_ID=... uv run scripts/gen_purchase_dates.py \
#       "path/to/Account.html" > purchase_dates.txt
# "Purchase" rows only (gifts/refunds excluded); earliest date wins per game;
# exact name match first, then word-aligned prefix matching (bundle rows use
# long marketing names like "Resident Evil 0 / biohazard 0 HD REMASTER");
# F2P acquisitions have no purchase row and stay last-played-only.
# (250/350 owned games matched on the 2026-09-27 export.)
